Meeting notes

Attendees: Silvia, Dan

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines a search step with a language model. Documents are split into chunks, embedded, and stored in a vector database. At query time the most relevant chunks are retrieved and added to the prompt. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) combines a search step with a language model. Documents are split into chunks, embedded, and stored in a vector database. At query time the most relevant chunks are retrieved and added to the prompt.
